Name: Derpy Tiger Pet Mod
Author: casualcozy
Description:
Currently, this mod replaces the art of an existing cat to make it resemble Derpy Tiger from KPop Demon Hunters. 

If you would like the Derpy Tiger kitty on a current save where you did not choose the first cat option, you can purchase him from Marnie :)

I hope to update the mod later to include the Top Hat as a giftable item from this cat, for now it is just aesthetic.

Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: This mod replaces the cat art for the first cat option in Stardew with a Derpy Tiger cat inspired by KPop Demon Hunters
